Spirii is looking for an Engineering Manager!

If you are passionate about cutting-edge software development technologies, leading agile teams, the EV industry, and creating outstanding products, join Spirii’s fantastic growth journey to lead the way for a sustainable future.

The Job

Spirii develops and provides world-class charging products and digital solutions to customers with electric cars. Our Digital Development department is proud to drive a listen, learn, and lead culture that allows us to constantly improve our ways of working. As Engineering Manager, you lead 1-2 of our engineering teams of 6–12 engineers and are accountable for making it a high-performing team. You own the people, the health of the team and the soundness of its engineering. You do this through others: Tech Leads and Senior Engineers guide the technical work day-to-day, and you make sure good decisions get made, quality stays high, and the team keeps getting better.

Spirii is adopting agentic development as the way we build software. AI agents are becoming part of how our engineers design, code, test, review and operate systems. You'll make it real in your team, working with colleagues across engineering to shape how we do it.

You work very closely with a Product Manager and a Designer. Product owns what we build and why; you own how well the team delivers it. You report to the Head of Engineering.

What You Will Do

Lead and grow your people

• 
Own the full people cycle for your team: hiring, onboarding, one-on-ones, feedback, career development, performance reviews and handling underperformance early and fairly.

• 
Build a team where people trust each other, take ownership and do their best work at a sustainable pace.

• 
Help your engineers grow, including senior engineers stepping into technical leadership.

Own team performance

• 
Be accountable for the team's delivery, predictability and quality, and for how it improves over time.

• 
Define with Product what good looks like, and track it with evidence such as delivery flow, reliability, and team health, not gut feeling.

• 
Turn priorities into clear commitments, make trade-offs visible, and protect the team so committed work gets finished.

Lead the shift to agentic development in your team

• 
Make agentic development part of how your team works every day, moving beyond individual experiments to shared practice.

• 
Adapt how work flows through your team as agents take on more of the building. That includes how work is specified, how code is reviewed and how quality is assured.

• 
Apply shared practices for quality, security and data handling as they develop, and stay accountable for what your team ships.

• 
Work with colleagues across engineering on how we adopt agentic development. Bring your team's needs and feedback, and help test and roll out new tools and practices.

• 
Track what agentic development changes for your team's delivery and quality, and share what you learn with other teams.

Ensure sound engineering

• 
Be accountable for the quality of your team's engineering decisions, including architecture, security, operational readiness, observability and technical debt, while your Tech Lead and engineers lead the design work.

• 
Make sure what the team ships is tested, observable and ready to run in production, and that incidents lead to real learning.

• 
Work with other Engineering Managers and Tech Leads to keep our platform and practices coherent across teams.

Collaborate across Spirii

• 
Partner with Product, Design, other departments and external consultants to align priorities and resolve dependencies.

• 
Communicate clearly and early about progress, risks and trade-offs.

Who You Are

• 
You care about people and want to build teams that grow, thrive and deliver.

• 
You hold a high bar for quality and for yourself, and you take ownership of results.

• 
You're genuinely excited about AI as the new way to build software. You want to be ahead of the curve, and you're curious about where it goes next.

• 
You're technical enough to challenge a design, read an incident and spot risk, even if you're not writing production code day to day.

• 
You communicate clearly with engineers, product people and leadership alike.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate has relevant experience with development of digital cloud-based solutions in an agile start-up environment and can take the responsibility for leading a team of developers.

We further look for a candidate with the following experience and personal traits:

• 
Relevant technical graduate degree at minimum bachelor level (engineer).

• 
3+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager with direct reports, including hiring, coaching and performance management.

• 
A background as a software engineer (backend or full-stack) building cloud-based solutions.

• 
Solid understanding of distributed systems, such as microservices and APIs, and what it takes to run them reliably in production.

• 
Experience improving engineering practices like automated testing, CI/CD, observability or incident management.

• 
Familiarity with DORA metrics or similar ways of measuring delivery.

• 
Experience making senior engineers and tech leads more effective, rather than doing their work for them.

It's an advantage if you have

• 
Experience leading a team's adoption of AI-assisted or agentic development, including changing practices, not just introducing tools.

• 
Experience with AWS and containerised workloads.

• 
Experience from eMobility products.

• 
Experience leading a team through organisational change.

The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but Fluent English language skills are required.

Benefits

It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work life balance.

• 
Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.

• 
Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.

• 
Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.

• 
Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.

• 
Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.

• 
Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym

• 
Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.

• 
Two innovation days per month for YOU to choose what you work on.

The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but Fluent English language skills are required.

About Spirii – Who We Are

Spirii is a full-service e-mobility provider which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. Spirii was founded seven years ago as a company. Nevertheless, the people in Spirii have extensive experience working with electric cars and charging, as well as the development of future transport- and energy systems.

Spirii is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. Spirii strives to create an inclusive and diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of age, gender, race, sexual/religious orientation, or disability.

People Manager for Library – Aarhus

Be a People Manager for experienced developers and help libraries across Europe strengthen the way they work. Join a business unit in fast growth that constantly wins new markets.

The job

As a People Manager, you will be the direct people manager for 10-15 experienced developers across Aarhus, and you coach teams in the Cicero Product Development organisation. Your primary task will be to make sure people feel supported and motivated, and to help the teams become better as a team.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Daily people leadership, including 1:1s, development conversations and performance management

• Creating culture and context by translating priorities, building psychological safety, representing the teams’ point of view upwards and resolving conflicts

• Supporting decisions with data, through better flow, effective reporting and dashboards

• Improving processes with Scrum Masters and teams, both within and across teams, including how we use AI across delivery

• Being part of the Product Development leadership group together with your Associate Director

Joining the team

We are around 70 colleagues in seven teams across Aarhus, Bucharest and Copenhagen. We develop Cicero, a library management system that helps libraries provide communities with knowledge, culture and connection essential to education and democratic societies. All teams run scrum and coordinate through PI Planning. We deliver into the same product, which is released every 14 days. AI is already an integrated part of our development teams, and you will help take it further.

Your qualifications

• A university degree preferred on a master’s level

• Experience within software development and management, or extensive process experience, e.g. as Scrum Master or project manager, and a wish to take the step into your first People Manager position

• Knowledge of Agile, Scrum, SAFe or PI Planning, and general management or project management skills

• Good Jira skills

• Strong communication skills in both Danish and English

On a personal level, you:

• Are comfortable holding both empathy and accountability in the same conversation

• Can influence without always having formal authority, using strong coaching skills

• Stay resilient when switching context between multiple teams and people

• Are comfortable using data to drive decisions

jobs.description:
Senior ERP Systems Consultant – AX 2012 & D365 F&O

Mission

**Do you want to take ownership of two generations of ERP systems at the world’s leading maritime supplier of provisions and stores?**Do you have strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012 and the ambition to play a key role in supporting our current platform while contributing to our transition to D365 F&O? Are you motivated by ensuring system stability and continuous improvement while helping shape the future of our ERP landscape?

If you are a technically strong ERP systems consultant who enjoys solving complex issues, collaborating across IT and the business, and building new capabilities for the future, this could be the opportunity for you.

Become part of our ERP team in Nørresundby, DenmarkReporting to our Team Lead, Thomas Jørsfeldt, you will become part of our ERP team, working closely with business consultants, developers, architects, integration specialists and stakeholders across our international organisation.

As a Senior ERP Systems Consultant, your initial focus will be our existing Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012 platform, where you will ensure system stability, performance, technical quality and continuous improvement. As we transition from AX 2012 to D365 F&O, your role will evolve alongside our ERP landscape.

Senior ERP Systems Consultant with a focus on AX 2012 and D365 F&OYou will be our senior technical expert on AX 2012, acting as the escalation point for complex issues and safeguarding critical system knowledge. Working closely with developers, architects and business consultants, you will balance technical debt, maintenance and business-requested enhancements while ensuring that solutions meet our development, documentation and architectural standards.

You will also bring critical AX 2012 knowledge into our transition to D365 F&O, building hands-on experience with the new platform and gradually taking on systems responsibility for the new solution. This is not just an AX 2012 role – it is an opportunity to take ownership across two generations of our ERP landscape and become a key part of our future D365 F&O organisation.

More specifically, your key responsibilities will be to:

• Act as the senior systems and technical expert for our Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012 environment, ensuring stability, performance, maintainability and architectural integrity.

• Troubleshoot complex technical issues and act as the escalation point for critical incidents.

• Work hands-on with AX 2012 development, X++, customisations, integrations, SQL Server and performance optimisation.

• Review technical solutions and ensure adherence to development, documentation and architectural standards, balancing technical debt, maintenance and business-requested enhancements.

• Protect and strengthen critical AX 2012 knowledge through documentation and knowledge sharing.

• Identify customisations, integrations, data dependencies and technical risks in the existing solution as input to the transition to D365 F&O.

• Contribute to solution assessment, data migration, testing, validation and cutover preparation in close collaboration with D365 F&O consultants, developers, architects and integration specialists.

• Build hands-on D365 F&O knowledge and progressively take on responsibility for the operation, maintenance, configuration, release readiness and continuous improvement of the new platform.

Profile

Qualifications & requirementsYou bring extensive hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012, supported by several years of experience from complex, business-critical ERP environments. You combine strong technical problem-solving skills with a structured approach to quality and documentation, and you are motivated by the opportunity to apply your AX 2012 expertise during the transition while developing your future role within D365 F&O.

Furthermore, we expect that you have:

• 3+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012, including System administration, development and architecture.

• Solid experience with X++ development and customization.

• Good understanding of SQL Server, databases, integrations and performance optimization.

• Experience from complex and business-critical ERP environments.

• Strong troubleshooting and analytical capabilities.

• The ability to balance operational stability, technical debt, transformation activities and business requirements.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills in English, with experience collaborating across functions and cultures.

• A structured and delivery-focused approach, with attention to quality, documentation and agreed deadlines.

It is an advantage if you have:

• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations.

• Experience from an AX 2012 to D365 F&O migration or another ERP transformation programme.

• Experience with Azure DevOps, Lifecycle Services, data entities, security, workflows or release management in D365 F&O.

• Knowledge of cloud ERP operations, automated testing or the Microsoft Power Platform.

• A relevant degree or Microsoft Dynamics certification.

Personality mattersYou are curious, analytical and collaborative, with a natural ability to take ownership and build trusted relationships across the business and IT. You enjoy solving complex problems, constructively challenging existing solutions and translating technical insight into sustainable improvements. You communicate clearly and thrive in an international environment where knowledge-sharing, teamwork and continuous improvement are key.

**We offer more than just a job

**We wish to be the best at what we do, and everything we do is based on our values of “Winning Attitude, Customer Orientation, and Getting it Done”. We offer flexible working hours and numerous employee benefits, counting a healthy canteen, take-away, free fruit, and fitness facilities. Wrist supports local elite sports, offering tickets to home games. You can expect free parking and access to Clever EV charging stations. Moreover, we have an active employee association that invites us all to play paddle, badminton, board games etc. and to join the yearly DHL relay race.

**Ready to apply?

**Please send us your application and CV via the “Apply” button. We want to fill the position as soon as possible and will continuously invite candidates for interviews, so do not hesitate to submit your application and CV.

If you have questions or want to know more about the team, please reach out to Team Lead, Thomas Jørsfeldt, at thjo@wrist.com or by phone on +45 2128 4416

**At Wrist, we are committed to cultivating a culture of belonging where every individual feels seen, valued, and respected

**As a global company, we aim to reflect the communities we are part of, believing that our strength comes from diverse perspectives, experiences, and the unique contributions each person offers. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, and we are dedicated to maintaining a recruitment process that is inclusive, fair, and respectful. By fostering a supportive workplace culture rooted in belonging, we lay the foundation for meaningful collaboration and shared success.

**About Wrist

**Wrist is the world’s leading ship and offshore supplier of marine provisions and stores with a market share of approximately 12%. We are the only provisions and stores marine supplier with a global network of supply operations. We also offer services within owners’ goods and spare parts logistics, combining provisions and stores deliveries directly to the vessels. With the launch of the digital marketplace, Source2Sea, Wrist is leading the digital transformation of the marine supply industry. All year round, we offer 24/7 global online sourcing and logistics, providing data transparency, automation, and convenience to our customers. We continuously work on reducing our climate impact while at the same time proactively addressing our customers’ growing demand and need for responsible solutions and services. From more than 30 locations worldwide, in all major shipping locations, 1,800 Wrist employees take pride in making it easy for our customers to order and receive marine supplies and services.

Head of Risk & Compliance Innovation

Help shape how Danske Bank manages risk and compliance through technology that makes a measurable difference. As Head of Risk & Compliance Innovation, you will build and lead a new team, turning complex challenges into practical products, scalable solutions and better ways of working. This is an opportunity to create a new capability and bring innovation into everyday practice across the Risk and Compliance function.

What you will be doing

You will lead a multidisciplinary team of approximately 15 colleagues, combining technology and product specialists with PMO and change-delivery professionals. Reporting to James Mackintosh, Head of Enterprise Risk Management, you will work across Risk and Compliance with senior leaders, subject-matter experts and Technology teams. More specifically, you will:

About you

• A strong track record of technology and product delivery, from concept through to production and measurable impact.

• Experience leading major transformation programmes across organisational boundaries.

• The ability to engage credibly with engineers, architects and data specialists, without needing to code directly.

You will be a collaborative, down-to-earth leader who provides clear direction, listens to different perspectives and helps colleagues turn ideas into practical results. Experience owning products while commissioning delivery from technology partners, or helping recover challenged programmes, would be valuable. Experience working with agile tribes and squads, aligning priorities with product owners and coordinating delivery across teams, would also be an advantage, as well as a background spanning technical delivery and change management.

What we offer you

You will join a collaborative environment where your work can make a meaningful difference to how a major bank manages risk. We offer a hybrid working model with three to four days per week in the office. You will have access to senior stakeholders, an organisation-wide mandate and the opportunity to build a new capability across Risk and Compliance.

jobs.occupation: Chief Flight Instructor at GreyBird Pilot Academy - HQ located at Aarhus Airport, DK –  Ready to shape the future of pilot training? ✈️
jobs.description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is more than a flight school. We are a fast-growing international business in an industry that never stands still – training the next generation of commercial pilots. Since starting out in Aarhus in 2013, we have grown to seven bases across Europe – from Dublin in the west to Helsinki in the east. Our students fly under the Spanish sun and across European airspace. Today, more than 200 students are training to become commercial pilots with us, supported by over 40 flight instructors and a fleet of 12 Tecnam aircraft, with 13 more on the way. This is where ambition becomes reality – where safety, people, technology, operations and training must all come together before the wheels leave the runway. You have an aviation background and have instructed from the cockpit yourself. With us, you will join a highly skilled team with short decision-making lines and plenty of room to shape our development. We turn the dream of flying into a career – and you can help make that journey even better.

The role

The Chief Flight Instructor (CFI) is part of our ATO Core Team and holds overall responsibility for quality, standardisation and compliance in the flight and simulator training delivered by our flight instructors. You are appointed by the Accountable Manager and report directly to the Head of Training, with whom you work closely to ensure consistent, high-quality training. The Head of Training may delegate tasks and authority to you within your area of responsibility. Your key responsibilities include:

• Standardisation, supervision and training planning for the entire instructor team

• Developing and enforcing standard operating procedures for flight training

• Ensuring that all instructors hold valid licences, certificates and competencies

• Recruiting new instructors as well as guiding, mentoring and providing recurrent training for the existing team

• Assessing new bases as we expand into new countries

• Updating training materials and operations manuals on our in-house platform, SmartBird

• Taking part in ATO and management meetings, where you help set the direction for training

What we offer:

• Real decision-making authority over training quality and standards in a growing international organisation

• A direct reporting line to the Head of Training and close ties to management

• An established ATO with a clear, EASA-approved framework for the role

• Access to a modern and growing fleet

• An international working environment with colleagues and instructors from several countries

Requirements

The Chief Flight Instructor is a nominated post under EASA Part-ORA (ORA.ATO.210). In line with the regulation, the CFI must hold the highest pilot licence and at least one instructor certificate relevant to the courses the school offers. As GreyBird offers ATPL theory, several aircraft types and type rating-related training, we are looking for:

• CPL(A) or ATPL(A)

• Instructor certificate: FI(A)

• Additional instructor certificates such as CRI(A) and IRI(A) are considered an advantage

• A minimum of 1,000 hours as PIC, including at least 500 hours of instructional flying (industry practice is typically 1,500+ hours, and more experience counts in your favour)

• Ideally, you also have experience leading, standardising or developing other instructors

• Fluent English, spoken and written

How to apply

Ready to set the course for a role where you shape the standards for the next generation of pilots? Send us your application today – we look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.description:
Make business change land — across 30+ markets in a global customer engagement platform implementation that is 80% people and process, 20% technology.

Join us in creating a future legacy in medical dermatology. At LEO Pharma, we are global leaders in medical dermatology with 115 years of experience bringing innovation to healthcare. In Global Customer Engagement Platforms & Excellence, we partner across the business to enable customer engagement excellence — empowering global and local teams to execute with impact. We are guided by simplification, collaboration, and accountability.

In Global Customer Engagement Platforms & Excellence, we partner across the business to drive customer engagement excellence - empowering global and local teams to execute with impact. We are guided by simplification, collaboration, and accountability. Now, as we embark on a global Customer Engagement Platform implementation affecting around 1,500 users across 30+ markets, we are looking for a Senior Business Change & Execution Lead to make sure change lands across LEO - so the platform is adopted, used, and delivers lasting value.

Your role

As Senior Business Change & Execution Lead, you will run the business-side change and delivery engine that turns strategy into outcomes. Working closely with the Head of Global Customer Engagement Platforms & Excellence, our Business Process Owners, Global IT, and implementation partners, you will ensure that governance runs, decisions move forward, markets are ready, and change lands - wave by wave during rollout, and release by release after go-live. Business Process Owners decide how processes should work; you make sure those decisions move, land, and stick.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Owning the business readiness and adoption roadmap across markets and rollout waves, covering milestones, risks and dependencies, aligned with Global IT's project plan.

• Driving change execution: readiness diagnostics, stakeholder mapping, communication and enablement plans, adoption tracking, and go-live preparation.

• Running the governance cadence, including Core Team and delegate forums, and preparing SteerCo decision material, with clear agendas, decision logs and follow-up.

• Leading regular touchpoints with market Business Leads, and coordinating across Global IT, implementation partners, platform vendors, regional teams and local markets.

• Creating executive materials, stakeholder communications, briefing packs and change narratives that reflect LEO Pharma's business context.

• After go-live: running the roadmap prioritisation process with Business Process Owners, and tracking adoption and business value so the platform keeps delivering.

You will also help ensure that learnings are captured and acted on throughout the implementation, so the approach improves wave by wave. This is not a passive coordination role — you will bring structure, recommendations, momentum, and follow-through.

Your qualifications

We imagine that you bring strong experience from complex business change, adoption, transformation, or global implementation environments. You know how to make change work in practice - not only how to design the framework.

We are especially looking for:

• Proven experience leading business change and adoption in large-scale, multi-market implementations.

• Hands-on experience with structured change methods such as ADKAR or equivalent; Prosci certification is a plus.

• Strong execution skills, including roadmaps, RAID, governance, delivery cadence, and readiness tracking.

• Experience defining and tracking adoption and business value metrics, and using them to drive prioritisation.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, including senior stakeholder and executive-level materials.

• Experience working with external implementation partners, platform vendors, and cross-functional global teams.

jobs.description:
**Your impact begins here

**As (Senior) Process Scientist, you will help move new tablet products from development into reliable, large-scale production. You will characterise, test, and validate tablet production processes so they work at manufacturing sites around the world, and prepare the documentation that supports market approval. Oral treatments are a strategic focus area at Novo and your work will help our patients and customers towards lasting health.

**What You’ll Bring

**

• An M.Sc. degree in Chemistry, Pharmacy, Engineering or another relevant academic area.

• Minimum 2 years of experience in oral product production, late-stage product development, drug product analysis, or clinical manufacturing

• General experience working within a GMP environment, knowledge of validation activities, and familiarity with regulatory documentation.

• Fluency in spoken and written English.

• Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with team success ahead of personal achievement.

• A self-driven, quality-minded approach, with good planning and time-management skills to meet ambitious deadlines.

• Comfort working with some unknowns and many stakeholders, and the ability to adapt, learn and stay in control when situations are challenging.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Experience from cross-organisational projects.

We welcome applications from both experienced and more junior candidates. The scope of the role can be adjusted to your level of experience, providing an opportunity to grow into the position. If you meet the core requirements, we encourage you to apply.

**What You’ll Do

**You will work on late-phase manufacturing science for new tablet products, preparing processes for large-scale market production.

**You Will Have The Opportunity To

**

• Drive scientific progress to reach project milestones, delivering on characterisation studies, test runs, and process validation activities.

• Work with production sites to solve technical challenges with blenders, granulators, tablet machines, in-process control systems, and process analytical technologies (PAT).

• Update and maintain critical process documentation, quality statements, scientific rationales and health authority submission files.

• Apply and uphold the relevant standards. Where a standard does not fully fit the situation, use your own scientific judgement to find the best way forward.

• Learn from how new ways of working meet reality at the sites, adapt your approach, and help update the standard so others can benefit.

The role is based in Taastrup, with some workdays in Måløv, and includes up to 25 international travel days a year, depending on your project.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join New Product Introduction (NPI) within Tablet Manufacturing Science and Technology (TMSAT) in Global Manufacturing & Supply (GMS). Tablet MSAT supports the global network of tablet manufacturing sites by introducing new products, managing the processes and quality of marketed products, and developing new technology to improve performance.

NPI is a rapidly growing department of around 20 colleagues, working with an expanding pipeline of tablet products. Together, we develop, scale up and validate blending, granulation and compression processes, and make sure the product’s stability, specifications and quality hold up. We work in cross-functional project groups, united by shared team goals, and we share experience and knowledge as we go.

You will collaborate closely with development departments, production sites, quality assurance, quality control, regulatory affairs and the scientists who support marketed products. The stakeholders you work with will change as projects move forward, so you will keep building your network.

**Oral treatments are a strategic focus area for Novo, and the landscape is dynamic. That means varied projects, new ways to broaden your skills and a chance to see your work make a difference at sites around the world. You will have a highly engaged, supportive team around you, and room to develop your professional and personal competences as the department grows.

**For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 638,200.00 to 938,100.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to take new tablet products from development to patients around the world, apply for the (Senior) Process Scientist role by 26 November 2026.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For further information, please contact Chris Arnrød Andersen, Director at ciaq@novonordisk.com or +45-30752190.

**

AI is the core of how our team builds software, including a shared AI development workflow. We expect you to use AI as your main development platform, or to be keen to. Hands-on experience with AI-first development is a big plus.

**

• Take features from the first idea to a device in the field, in close collaboration with our firmware and hardware teams.

• Helping attract and win new airline services, tour operators and air freight providers among other business development opportunities by way of sharp and investigative analysis

• Work astutely with market intelligence and data – from reporting, analysing, market-sizing and trend development, to identifying, researching and underpinning new business opportunity by smartly applying business acumen

• Develop a grasp and detailed understanding of population dynamics, socio-economic, migration and immigration as well as regional economic trends across Denmark and applicable international communities, as well as trade and tourism

• Using both new and available data and analytical methodology, support the commercial activity, sales, marketing and communication initiatives of the organisation

• Produce, research and maintain analytical and insight tools to help optimally showcase Aarhus Airport’s market, regional economy and destination assets

• Support the knowledge-building of AAR’s work in economic, aviation and wider industry trends

• Support work with stakeholders and business partners from around the industry and region including tourism partners, corporate customers, airlines and tour operator partners

• Assist with applicable project management and business development by way of competent planning, modelling, budgeting and forecasting

• Assist in commercial calculations, analysis and negotiations with management and leadership, in pursuit of incremental revenue sustainability and asset optimisation

• Co-operate closely with marketing, communications, administration, customer service and operational colleagues

• Strong skill sets in analytical, business and/or commercial arena and ideally some international work experience, or a very significant interest in this field. Perhaps you have worked in travel already or are keen to do so, maybe an interest in airport, airline and the travel sector in general

Would you like to drive the commercial growth of a world-leading protein analysis contract research organization (CRO)? Alphalyse seeks a commercially driven Marketing Director to strengthen our market position and win new biopharmaceutical clients worldwide.

About the role

As Marketing Director, you will own Alphalyse’s marketing strategy and brand and be the central point for everything we communicate to the market. You will lead and develop our marketing function and work closely with management, sales, and our scientific experts. You will take ownership, set priorities, make decisions, and turn ideas into coordinated, high-quality material that reaches our clients.

Our market consists of a limited number of biopharmaceutical companies, and many of them do not yet know what modern protein analysis can do for them. Educating the market is therefore a key part of the job, and so is making sure that our strong scientific profile is matched by a clear commercial message.

The position is based at our headquarters in Odense, Denmark, and you will lead our communications specialist and work closely with our sales and business development teams in both Denmark and the United States.

Your responsibilities

• Develop and execute the marketing strategy and plan, aligned with our commercial goals

• Be the guardian of the Alphalyse brand, and own the communication plan, PR, and our external newsletter

• Identify target accounts and decision-makers, and run account-based campaigns that generate qualified leads

• Educate the market through webinars, case studies, and thought leadership.

• Define the right marketing KPIs, track performance, and adjust quickly based on what generates pipeline

• Be the landing place for good ideas from across the organization for client material, posts, and content. Decide what to pursue and turn it into finished output

• Coordinate all marketing material, so our messaging is consistent across channels, client meetings, sales, and events

• Plan and run conferences and events, and make sure we show up with strong material

• Lead and develop our communications specialist, and act as a business development partner to sales and management

Who you are

You are a commercially minded marketing leader with high personal drive and a hands-on approach. You thrive on handling many different activities at once and keep momentum without losing sight of priorities. You are a strong communicator, an engaged people leader, and a natural sparring partner for management and sales. You quickly grasp complex technical offerings and explain their value clearly to scientists and decision-makers alike. You are an early adopter of AI and always look for smarter ways of working.

Professional qualifications

Required

• Deep B2B marketing and branding experience at a strategic level, including developing and implementing marketing strategies

• Proven track record of marketing a niche, technical B2B product or service to a small, well-defined customer base

• Strong commercial instincts and comfort being measured on pipeline and revenue

• A proven ability to turn strategy into execution across PR, content, events, campaigns, and product launches

• Experience leading and developing employees, including setting priorities and making decisions for a team

• Excellent written and spoken English

Preferred

• Experience with account-based marketing and CRM tools

• Experience educating a market about new technologies or services

• Experience with websites, digital marketing, and video content

• Knowledge of the biopharmaceutical industry, life science, or analytical techniques

What we offer

• A senior role with real influence on Alphalyse’s commercial strategy and growth

• The chance to shape our marketing as the company grows

• Close collaboration with management, a world-class scientific team and our sales organization

• A market where regulatory change is creating new demand for our services

Are you interested?

To apply, please send your CV to job@alphalyse.com no later than 10 December 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. If you have questions about the role, please contact CEO Thomas Kofoed at +45 2045 2038.

About Alphalyse

Alphalyse is a Danish contract research laboratory founded in 2002. We use our passion for protein analysis to help clients develop safe and effective biopharmaceuticals. An innovative approach has made us world leaders in quantifying Host Cell Proteins using a unique mass spectrometry method.

Our technical experts make the analysis results accessible to understand and use, and they take pride in building strong and rewarding relationships with our clients. Our most important asset is our team of highly skilled employees, and we encourage a work environment that is exciting, challenging, and fun.

Learn more at www.alphalyse.com

You'll be part of the PL40 Engineering organization and work closely with our Global Product Data Management team, connecting colleagues, systems and processes across different functions and locations. From maintaining critical product information to supporting new product development and global system implementations, your work will help teams make better decisions and operate more efficiently.

**
